blockers.message: REALTIME_EVENT_AGGREGATOR groupFields is required. Which fields define the aggregation key? (e.g. ["accountNumber"] or ["accountNumber", "subscriptionNumber"])
REALTIME_EVENT_AGGREGATOR aggregation source field is required. Which event field should be aggregated?

hints.groupFields: event field names from schema properties to group by (e.g. ["accountNumber"])
hints.aggregationFields[].field: event field name from schema properties to aggregate
hints.aggregationFields[].aggregation: SUM | MIN | MAX | AVG | COUNT | DELTA
hints.aggregationFields[].targetField: output field name; defaults to source field name if omitted
